target.title: fix(plugins): validate pattern-based and conditional config schemas
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where plugin config schemas with an empty explicit `properties` map were classified as empty even when `patternProperties`, `dependentSchemas`, or an active `if` plus `then`/`else` conditional imposed real validation rules. Valid pattern-keyed plugin configuration could therefore be rejected as “config must be empty,” while active conditional constraints could be skipped.

## Why This Change Was Made

The empty-schema shortcut now recognizes pattern and dependency constraints and only treats conditionals as active when `if` is paired with `then` or `else`. Standalone `if`, `then`, and `else` remain on the empty-config path because JSON Schema gives them no independent validation effect.

The implementation was checked against the repository's actual validator dependency, TypeBox 1.3.3: its coverage table and compiler source support `patternProperties`, `dependentSchemas`, and `if/then/else`, and its conditional engine defaults missing branches to `true`.

## User Impact

Plugin authors can use pattern-keyed and active conditional config schemas without the loader incorrectly requiring an empty config. Semantically inactive standalone conditional keywords do not bypass the empty-config guard.

## Evidence

Exact PR head `ad9481fcfc88711b8cc352bd9a9377044b94827f`, directly invoking the production `validatePluginConfig` integration path:

```text
pattern-valid: {"ok":true,"value":{"S_SETTING":"configured"}}
pattern-invalid: {"ok":false,"error":["S_SETTING: must be string"]}
active-then: {"ok":false,"error":["<root>: must match \"then\" schema"]}
standalone-if: {"ok":false,"error":["<root>: config must be empty"]}
standalone-then: {"ok":false,"error":["<root>: config must be empty"]}
standalone-else: {"ok":false,"error":["<root>: config must be empty"]}
exact_head=ad9481fcfc88711b8cc352bd9a9377044b94827f
```

Focused loader regression test:

```text
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/plugins/loader-shared.test.ts
Test Files  1 passed (1)
Tests       7 passed (7)
```

Additional checks:

```text
$ ./node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check src/plugins/loader-shared.ts src/plugins/loader-shared.test.ts
All matched files use the correct format.

$ ./node_modules/.bin/oxlint src/plugins/loader-shared.test.ts
# no output

$ git diff --check
# no output
```

Fresh autoreview was attempted before commit, but the engine failed before producing findings because the Responses WebSocket returned HTTP 403. No autoreview-clean claim is made.

AI-assisted: yes. I reviewed the complete empty-schema decision, both loader callers, the production schema validator, and TypeBox's direct dependency contract.
